purpose: Smoke run and sizing of the main run: every local model of the main run served by the pinned server on runner CPUs, each with latency (E3) and the six-site simulation on the small plant (sim), whose sizing table gives each model's per-call medians and suggested minutes, and the canary leakage scan with the model in the loop (G0). G0 uses a-1p5b, not the smallest model, because a-0p5b answered only 2 of 3 short calls in the check run.
